title: Configuration Space
purpose: Introduce centered labelled nuclear configurations and commuting actions.
panels: (a) Water configuration and matrix with columns matched to labels. (b) Rotation and relabeling on opposite sides. Optional small water shape grid if it remains legible.
verify: Center underlying coordinates from declared masses; check Xm=0, P_st=P_t P_s and commuting actions. Generate glyph/tick parameters from the same data.
avoid: A shape family is not a chart of full C. Rotation is general matrix multiplication, not simply a permutation of rows.

title: Ambient Hilbert Space
panels: (a) Selected configurations and explicitly labelled spin values. (b) Two orthonormal spin vectors with component functions and squared norm.
verify: Illustrative samples do not define an L2 function pointwise intrinsically. Mark regular representative illustration; allow superposition, not only tensor products.
avoid: No tangent plane masquerading as spin space; do not impose exchange constraints early.

title: Physical Hilbert Space
purpose: Pair nuclear relabeling with spin-factor permutation; distinguish statistics and inversion parity.
panels: (a) Fixed positions with labels exchanged. (b) Product-value example with scalar statistics prefactor outside full tensor product. (c) Separate parity inset if helpful.
verify: Check isotope/spin assumptions and tensor ordering. Preserve a.e. equality convention. Pointwise fixed-configuration constraints require additional regularity.
avoid: No physical exchange trajectory, separability restriction, or parity/statistics conflation.

title: Molecules, Fragments, and Complexes
purpose: Show one framework supports intra- and intermolecular fragment groupings.
panels: (a) Methylamine partition into methyl/amino fragments with clear reference drawing. (b) KRb pair with grouping boundaries. Optional separate channel inclusion panel.
verify: Partition choice changes boundaries, not positions. Fragment rigidity is a modeling approximation. Declare schematic complex connectivity.
avoid: Grouping is not bond formation. Molecules need not be called complexes in conventional chemistry. Inclusion is not yield or accessibility.

title: Symmetry Groups and Versions
purpose: Construct H as rotational-orbit stabilizer, then feasible G and reference versions.
panels: (a) Methylamine labels and verified rotation-equivalent operation. (b) Selected H,G6,G12,B chain or verified readable interval. (c) Molecular reference-version drawings.
verify: Current labels: methyl H1-3, amino H4-5, C6,N7; b=(23)(45)*,t=(123),u=(45). Verify closure, cosets, stabilizers and any Hasse covers.
avoid: G/H need not be a group. Inclusion does not establish a continuous path. Circle orbit samples do not imply SO(3)=S1.

title: Feasible Configuration Space
purpose: Distinguish reduced reference family, normal neighborhood, and symmetry-related components.
panels: (a) Defined reduced torsion/umbrella model. (b) Local normal thickening with sparse hatch. (c) S/G-indexed disjoint-image schematic, highlighting one image.
verify: Separate reference family from thickened F. Derive coordinate actions and version positions. Declare separation/product assumptions; 20 images for stated methylamine G12 model.
avoid: No unproved global product. No cylinder wall silently representing normal directions. Component positions are schematic, not a physical grid.

title: Symmetry Species
purpose: Resolve three version states into A1 and one E subspace.
panels: (a) Three cosets with t and b actions. (b) Chosen normalized coefficient basis on identical ordered sites.
verify: Order (H,tH,t²H); verify vectors (1,1,1)/sqrt3,(2,-1,-1)/sqrt6,(0,1,-1)/sqrt2 and action matrices. Distinguish orthonormal abstract version states from overlapping packets.
avoid: Two E basis vectors are not two E copies. No energy assignments.

title: Nuclear Spin Weights
purpose: Pair spatial symmetry with nuclear spin and parity.
panels: (a) Compact allowed tensor-sector pairing. (b) Proper table or clean plot with separate dimension, multiplicity and spin-weight definitions.
verify: Recompute five-proton G6 parity weights under current species conventions. Even A1/A2/E=12/4/8; odd4/12/8 as baseline. Weighted dimension sums=32. Explain whether weights count copies or components.
avoid: Absent scalar A2 in fig7 does not mean absent spin sector. Comparative molecules require separate geometry/isotope/group definitions.

title: Localized States
purpose: Connect packet width, overlap and spatial projection shares.
panels: (a) Equilateral planar Gaussian model, dimensioned edge d, contours sigma and2sigma. (b) Computed shares versus sigma/d. Optional compact-support inset.
verify: Density variance sigma²; c=exp(-d²/(8sigma²)); shares ((1+2c)/3,2(1-c)/3,0). Limits and sum rule. Each width is a different packet.
avoid: Toy distances are not exact molecular metric. Contours are not support boundaries. No time-evolution reading; hard support optional.

title: Position Representation
purpose: Reconstruct configurations in local coordinates and show actual transition/gluing.
panels: (a) Reference curve and mass-normal slice. (b) X=r(X0(q)+sum Q_a e_a(q)). (c) One explicit source-target map or seam.
verify: Regular domain, chart density, mass orthogonality, compensating rotation and normal matrix. Axial redundancy for linear configurations. Derive reduced cell partition if used.
avoid: No global product from local chart. No ordinary page right angle as proof of mass orthogonality. Frame choice not mechanical transport.

title: Covering Spaces and Monodromy
purpose: Explain local covering lifts and noncommuting continuation.
panels: (a) V with12 local sheets in6 coset pairs. (b) Enlarged X,bX pair. (c) t then b versus b then t with matching quotient loops.
verify: Free action domain must be stated; H stabilizes orbit not point. Deck action left; continuation right. btb=t^-1; tbX differs from btX=t²bX. Verify connectivity if relevant.
avoid: Reduced cylinder is not full covering space. No Berry or mechanical connection implied. Two local lifts are not duplicate configurations.

title: Momentum Representation
purpose: Describe same states in modes with seam-consistent labels.
panels: (a) Compact position/mode correspondence. (b) K rows periodic/twisted, kappa=m+rho K, origins and unit spacing. (c) Torsional real-mode species.
verify: Check Wigner convention and seam jointly; specify illustrative rho; J>=|K|; density absorption; constant A1, nonzero3-divisible cosine A1/sine A2, other pair E; sine0 absent.
avoid: Transform and frame change are distinct. No energy curve without Hamiltonian. Do not import old torsional-band dynamics.
